title: Direct or reported? Match the sentences
instructions: Statement, question or command? Match each sentence in **direct speech** with the right sentence in **reported speech**.
hint: Statement → *said*; yes/no question → *asked if*; command → *told … to*; request → *asked … to*.

pairs: She said she had been cold.
She asked if I was cold.
She told me to close the window.
She told me not to close the window.
He said he would call me.
He said he had called me.
He asked if I could call him.
He asked me to call him.
He asked me where I lived.
